en: Yeah, but things at home are kinda tense.
Try to be considerate. I know that sounds obvious, but things are going to be a little rough for your brother.
That's true. Plus, I think my brother at least has an idea of what he wants to do.
In that case, your family should do what they can to support his dreams. It won't help if the people around him are negative.
But won't that put more pressure on him if he doesn't meet our expectations?
Maybe, but it's better than just ignoring the issue. If he feels like no one cares about him, then he'll have no reason to try.
I guess that's a good point.
Oh, this sucks! Why do I have to be the one to always worry about these things?
Because you're a responsible sister.
Leave things be. If you make too big of a deal about it, it's likely to come across as overbearing.
In that case, you're better off keeping out of his business until he's figured things out on his own.
If he's got strong ambitions, he might rebel against anyone who tries to tell him what to do.
For now, he's going to keep his part-time job. It has nothing to do with his dream, but it's at least better than not working at all.
And some people are able to move up from part-time to full-time work. Maybe he'll decide to do that.
Ugh, dreams can be a real pain, huh?
What about yourself? I can't imagine being a hostess is a full time career.
Well, yeah. That's what makes it tough. Finding a "real" job is next to impossible these days.
Well, I wouldn't say it's impossible.
Alright, geez. You don't have to be so nitpicky!
Oh! Maybe you can talk to my brother, Kiryu-san! You've got tons of life experience, and you'd probably get through to him better than I could!
I guess that's true enough. Bring him along with you next time.
Welcome. Can I start you off with something to drink?
(This is Virtua Fighter MVJC pachinko machine number 3. Maybe I should give it a try.)
(No, let's not.)
(I'm too broke to play. I need at least 1,000 yen.)

Let's get going, then.
Yeah. Oh, Nakajima-san wanted me t'give ya a few driving tips while we're at it.
Bet I'm the last guy ya wanna hear advice from, but just indulge an old man.
Not at all. I appreciate it.
All right, off we go!
Thanks. Y'really saved my skin there.
My pleasure. Your advice was very helpful.
I'm glad. If there's ever anythin' else I can help with, just say the word.
Good luck out there.
Oh, there's a taxi.
You taking passengers?
Sure, get in.
Sorry for the wait. I'm here from Nagasu Taxi.
Oh, no worries. I'd like to go to <Color:22>Ose Bridge<Color:Default>, please!
(She's quite attractive. But...)
(She has a huge nose hair sticking out!)
Hm? Is something wrong?
Oh, no. I was just nosing⑬ <Italic>noticing</Italic> something. Please, get in.
Nice day, isn't it?
It is.
(...She really has no idea there's a nose hair dangling right above her upper lip. What should I do?)
I notice you have a little nose hair poking out there.
<Italic>Excuse me</Italic>? That is so rude. Haven't you ever heard of <Italic>tact</Italic>?
(You don't need to get so angry. I was only trying to help.)
Anyway, I've got a date today, so I'd appreciate it if you didn't bother me.
(...If she plans on attracting anyone at all, she needs to be aware of her nostril situation.)
(But she'll only think I'm making fun of her again unless I try something more subtle.)
Got some kind of special occasion today?
Oh, thanks for asking! Actually, I'm going on my very first date!
Is that right?
Hehe, yeah. I was never really the popular girl in school.
But I gathered up the courage to ask this guy I like out to dinner, and he said yes!
Then you're off to a good start.
Aww, thanks!
So, I did a little research into the things he likes, and I bought myself a new outfit, complete with complementing purse!
I think I'm good to go, but I'm still a bit nervous, it being my first date and all.
I can be a bit scatterbrained sometimes, so I hope I haven't forgotten anything.
(So she's going on a date, huh? Better point out that nose hair after all.)
(But, I wouldn't want to crush her confidence, either. I think I should use some subtlety here.)
(I should just keep my mouth shut... Hope I can still concentrate on driving.)
Ooh, I hope my date goes well! ♪ I spent hours picking out clothes and doing my hair...
Um... Do you think I look all right?
Oh, uh, of course.
(So she's going on a date. I'd better not ignore that nose hair, then.)
(At the same time, I wouldn't want to crush her confidence, either. Subtlety would work best here.)

Good luck with that date of yours. You're welcome to put the
finishing touches on your makeup in here if you want.
Do you take me for that kind of woman?
You know, those ladies who do their makeup in public, like when they're on the train.
It's just gross to do it in front of people like that. That's why I never carry around makeup or a mirror.
(What if I pointed the rearview mirror at her... real casually?)
(I think she noticed.)
Here's the fare! Take this tip as well.
Yes. Thank you for, um... yeah!
No problem. I hope your date goes well.
Me too! Wish me luck!
Here's the fare. And, uh... thanks for everything!
To be honest, I think you need to learn how to be more respectful toward women. That behavior back there was shameful.
I apologize for any misunderstandings I may have caused.
Yeah, well. Goodbye.
I'm here from Nagasu Taxi. You called?
(He must be fresh out of university. Wonder why he looks so exhausted.)
Yeah, I need to go to <Color:22>Chikuzengawa Street<Color:Default>.
Then let's be on our way.
Could you, uh, just leave the meter on and drive around a bit?
They monitor salespeople like me using GPS these days, so we always have to be out toiling away. Can't just kill extra time at a café.
You're not supposed to be killing time. At your age, you're supposed to be working hard.
...You ever worked in sales, driver?
Then you have no idea what you're talking about! My job is no walk in the park!
Don't assume you can lecture people just because you're older.
(...I think I made him angry. Better watch what I say to him from now on.)
I apologize. I didn't mean to offend you.
Ah, don't sweat it. I'm probably just a little riled up...
Truth is, I've only been at this job six months and I'm already thinking about leaving.
The company you work for sounds pretty harsh.
I can't believe they'd run you into the ground like that.
Sounds like a real hellhole.
Well, it's not <Italic>that</Italic> bad...
I appreciate you hearing me out and all, but badmouthing my company isn't helping, okay?
It's a pretty prestigious place, and I only got in after passing some really hard exams.
Oh. Sorry, I didn't mean...
That's okay. But, that being said, I'm already thinking of leaving, in spite of all the trouble I went through.
You must be really tired. I've never worked in sales myself, but I hear it's pretty tough.
Thanks for understanding. Feels good to talk to someone who actually gets me.
Hey, you mind if I get a few things off my chest? Seems like you might know what I'm talking about.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
The truth is, I've only been at this job six months and I'm already thinking about leaving.
I was hoping to get assigned to planning or production, but they had to go put me in sales...
I have absolutely no interest in this kind of work. It's a real struggle to get motivated, if you know what I mean.
All I think about these days are ways to avoid doing my job.
At this rate, I'd be better off quitting, don't you think?
If the job doesn't interest you, then why don't you leave?
Yeah, that's what I was thinking! Quitting is the best move, right?
I think so. You only live once, so you should do something that keeps your interest.
You're absolutely right! Thanks for the advice!
The same goes for you, huh? You always wanted to drive a taxi?
Wait, so this isn't your dream job?
...Now that you mention it, no.
Well that kind of undermines your point...
No, I think once you join a company, you should stick with it until you retire.
But the thought of having to keep doing this boring job for decades makes me cringe.
There are some things you can only learn through perseverance, like patience and willpower.
Patience and willpower? I'll admit I don't have either of those things right now.
Huh, then maybe sticking with this job is best after all. How long have you been in your line of work?
Uh... I switched to driving taxis six months ago.
What about your last job?
I... had to quit.
Hey, what happened to patience and willpower?
That kind of undermines your point, you know.
If there's another job you'd rather do, I think it's fine to leave.
That's a fair point. But that's also kind of the problem.
I can't really think of anything I'd rather do.
Do you know of any good jobs out there?
Hmm, what kind of work do you enjoy?
Heh, if I knew that, I'd have already switched jobs.
Say, do you like the job you're doing now, as a driver?
Yeah, it's actually pretty interesting.
Huh, you're lucky you found a job you like. Maybe I'll try driving a taxi as well.
But I enjoy it because I take it seriously.
As long as you have the right attitude, you can make any job interesting.
That's... enlightening. Perhaps if I take my sales position more seriously, I'll end up enjoying it.
Right. Maybe try making your decision after you've given it a little more effort.
You're right! I guess how you approach your work determines whether or not you find it rewarding.
Then... Dang, I shouldn't be wasting time here. I've got a job to do!
No, it's incredibly boring.

Then, is it that everyone's working a job they hate because
they have to, not because they want to?
Hmm. Maybe I should just force myself to keep doing this thankless job.
Even then... I'd still be just as depressed. *sigh* Why's life gotta be so hard?
I've never really thought about it.
Oh really...
Huh, maybe it's naive of me to think that work can be both interesting and rewarding.
I guess I'll just do my best to keep calm and carry on. Best not to overanalyze things, right?

Thanks for sharing your wisdom. Even if it was sort of a
harsh life lesson.
Hey, thanks for the ride! I'm ready to give it another shot!
(Good to see that he's cheered up.)
Here's the fare. Let me add a little something on top!
All right, time to get some work done!
Here's the fare.
Guess I'll get some work done, eh?
